line.en: A new true animal fact every day, told by Soya the cat, with its source and a tuna rating for trust, plus a true-or-false game that busts animal myths. English, Hebrew and French.
line.he: עובדה אמיתית חדשה על חיות בכל יום, מפי סויה החתול, עם המקור ודירוג טונה לאמינות, ומשחק נכון או לא נכון שמנפץ מיתוסים. אנגלית, עברית וצרפתית.

limit: It has 13 facts and 4 myths so far, all checked against Wikipedia; new ones are added each week.

works: A new fact every day, the same for everyone on that date
Each fact links to its source with a tuna rating for trust
True or false? busts common animal myths
English, Hebrew and French, dark cartoon look, works offline
next: Facts from more careful sources, such as museums and zoos
later: Readers send an animal they want to know about
